strings.sync.label: Cloud save: {status}
strings.sync.sheet.title: Cloud save
strings.sync.sheet.local: Your progress lives on this phone. It saves to your account once you're online.
strings.sync.sheet.synced: Your progress is saved to your account.
strings.sync.sheet.syncing: Saving your progress to your account.
strings.sync.sheet.offline: No connection. Keep playing: your progress is saved on this phone and goes to your account when you're back online.
strings.sync.sheet.paused: Your account save is paused because the server could not accept this save. Keep playing on this phone; we'll try again later.
strings.sync.sheet.update: Your account has a save from a newer version of the game. Reload to update, then it saves again.
strings.sync.sheet.behind: This phone's game is from before your last prestige, so it can't replace your account's game. Use your account's game instead.
strings.sync.sheet.conflict: This phone and your account have different progress. Pick the one to keep. The other is replaced.
